Olá Lisboa! Say hello to our fun-loving office in the Portuguese capital.

## About us

Pipedrive made a splash in Lisbon during Web Summit 2016, and our journey took off with the opening of our Lisbon office in 2017. After a few moves, we’re thrilled to call our vibrant Casal Ribeiro space home as of 2023.

With over 200 talented individuals from 25+ countries, Lisbon is one of our engineering hubs. But it’s our customer-facing teams that truly shine – they’re the heartbeat of our mission to keep users smiling. It’s a great place to work, collaborate and have fun while making a real impact!

## Our traditions

At our Lisbon office, we thrive on community and collaboration. We cherish lunch breaks to recharge, and as foodies, our official office cake is the delightful Bola de Berlin (bet you thought it was Pastel de Nata). The Lisbon office is also one of the few Pipedrive locations that goes all out for its birthday, a tradition the team takes very seriously.

With such a talented team of customer solutions experts, we host regular “One Day in Your Shoes” events to show off the incredible results they deliver for our customers. The year closes with our festive winter awards show, honoring achievements with sparkle, applause and shared pride.

## Where you’ll find us

Our Lisbon office is based at Avenida Casal Ribeiro, in Saldanha – right in the middle of the Lisbon business district.

We share our office building with other exciting digital companies, but our lovely terrace on the first floor is exclusively for Pipedrivers! Our all-hands area has an auditorium for regular company-wide meetings, a kitchen filled with snacks and drinks (including yummy ice cream) and a gaming area. # Tallinn

Welcome to Tallinn, where Pipedrive was born.

Come and join Pipedrive’s Tallinn team!

See open positions

## About us

Pipedrive was born in Tallinn. What started as a small startup in a shared office has grown into an international company with an entire building in Tallinn’s vibrant WoHo quarter. Today, Tallinn is home to our engineering and product hub, where 300+ team members from 30+ nationalities work together – many of them engineers.

Pipedrive is proud to be Estonia’s fifth unicorn and has consistently been recognized as one of the best places in the country to work since 2016, according to both the media and our employees. And we’re not just about jobs – at Pipedrive, you’ll have the chance to grow, learn and make a real impact by helping shape a product used by more than 100,000 companies worldwide.

## Our traditions

At Pipedrive, we love to celebrate the moments that matter – from birthdays and work anniversaries to promotions. One of our most beloved traditions is getting together for *Kringle*, a classic Estonian pastry, though you’ll also see pizza, donuts or pancakes make an appearance. To make sure no celebration goes unnoticed, we’ve got a kitchen-alert Slack channel to keep everyone in the loop.

Our biggest annual event is the Summer Garage – a full-day celebration that brings teams together to connect, unwind and enjoy live music performed by our very own band (and sometimes a guest artist or two).

We also host occasional hackathons and innovation accelerators to spark new ideas for improving the product and how we work together.

We believe in a balance of fun and focus. From Lightning Talks where anyone can practice their presentation skills with a topic they care about, to Sudoku tournaments and gaming challenges organized by teammates, there’s always something to get involved in.

We’re also proud to contribute to the wider community: Our team actively supports the local engineering, product and HR scenes in Estonia by hosting in-house meetups, participating in conferences and speaking at events.

Staying active outside of work is also a big part of our culture. Whether it's a friendly game of table tennis, a disc golf match or a padel session – one of the most popular sports among our Tallinn team – there's always fun going on.

## Where you’ll find us

You’ll find us in Tallinn’s modern WoHo district, where our custom-designed office makes it easy to feel at home. Each of our eight themed floors – park, nature, sports, IT, music, art, movies and culture – is fully immersive. Whether you’re jamming on the music floor’s instruments or exploring the art gallery, there’s something for everyone.

The heart of the office is our all-hands area, where people gather for a coffee or something else from our well stocked kitchens. # Senior Machine Learning Engineer

**YOUR MISSION AT VOI**

You will be joining a team focused on predicting the near-future demand for our vehicles. Specifically, where and when they will be needed, and how to handle this at scale for a fleet of 150 thousand vehicles spread across over more than 100 cities. This is a complex and meaningful problem from both an analytical as well as an engineering perspective, and you'll be handed ambiguous, high-leverage problems and are expected to reason from first principles about what to build — not a spec to implement.

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Voi, you'll work closely with a small, cross-functional team to design, build and maintain machine learning models. You will work on problems where you will get to utilize your skills in such interrelated disciplines as machine learning, AI engineering, software engineering, data science, optimization as well as data engineering.

*Your responsibilities will include:*

* Own and contribute to end-to-end machine learning and AI projects, in close collaboration with business stakeholders, and the rest of your team
* Formulating solution hypotheses, defining data requirements, prototyping, implementing in production, and continuously monitoring model health and business impact
* Maintain and improve Voi's machine learning platform to ensure our machine learning products adhere to state-of-the-art MLOps standards, with support from the team
* Work with colleagues to improve team processes and support mutual learning and knowledge sharing

**WHAT YOU NEED TO EMBARK**

We’re looking for a Machine Learning professional with experience from a fast-paced environment. In addition to being fluent in English, we believe the right person has:

* A clear focus on business value and user impact
* A strong analytical mindset, and comfortable setting up simplified first-principles models for complex problems, built on well-thought-through assumptions
* Forward-leaning attitude towards LLM-based and agentic approaches: you explore new AI tooling before it’s obviously the standard, and pair that curiosity with strong Python and software engineering fundamentals
* Experience contributing to projects from start to finish, from understanding business challenges to planning, building, launching and following up on results
* Hands-on experience with real-time inference and/or MLOps in one of the major cloud environments
* Experience writing production-quality, maintainable software
* Higher education in one of the mathematical sciences such as computer science, mathematics, physics, bioinformatics or with a similar data-centric degree

*Don’t meet every requirement? If you are excited about this role and our mission, and have relevant, transferable skills, we encourage you to apply – even if you don’t check every box.*

# Senior Software Engineer - SDK

San Francisco, CA

Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

**Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI):** Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

### **About the role and Team**

At Amplitude, millions of developers instrument their products to understand how users behave. The first code they write with Amplitude is almost always through an SDK. That means our SDKs are **not just integrations, they are the developer experience of Amplitude itself.** We're building a new kind of SDK team:

Most companies hire SDK engineers per language.

We don't.

We're recruiting **AI-assisted SDK wizards**, engineers who:

* learn new languages quickly
* use AI to accelerate development
* build tooling to scale SDK maintenance
* own developer experience end-to-end

This role has unusually **large scope and autonomy**

**What You'll Work On**

* Build and maintain SDKs across many languages (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, Swift, Rust)
* Use AI to scale SDK development - build systems that allow a small team to maintain many SDKs
* Own developer experience - improve how developers integrate with Amplitude
* Optimize SDK for latency, performance, bundle size, resource load
* Create external-facing agents that take advantage of the signals collected by our SDKs
* Build integrations with third parties
* Drive high engineering standards while knowing when speed beats perfection.
* Create a culture where people love the work, move fast, and deliver real outcomes.

### **About the job:**

The Product Owner for CSM Applications plays a critical role in shaping how Customer Success engages, operates, and delivers value at scale. In this role, you will serve as the primary business owner for our CSM Applications, defining the vision, roadmap, requirements, and cross-functional alignment needed to turn business needs into delivered outcomes.

You will partner closely with Operations, Customer Success leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to understand business processes, identify opportunities, prioritize enhancements, and translate requirements into actionable work for the CSM Applications Admins and supporting systems teams.

This role is accountable for sprint planning, backlog prioritization, delivery, and ensuring our CSM Applications programs and features drive measurable impact across the customer lifecycle. While the CSM Applications Admins will handle the majority of system configurations, you will be expected to contribute hands-on support when needed to ensure timely delivery.

This is a key position within Post-Sales Applications, balancing product strategy, business analysis, program management, and technical aptitude to help our CSM teams work smarter, faster, and more effectively.
